tickets.title: Full Page Architecture
tickets.description: Builds a complete landing page featuring a hero section with gradient text, a feature bento-grid, a pricing table, and a footer. Must be fully responsive and support dark mode.
tasks: Builds a complete landing page featuring a hero section with gradient text, a feature bento-grid, a pricing table, and a footer. Must be fully responsive and support dark mode.
learning_objectives: Master Tailwind's CSS Grid utility classes.
tickets.evaluation: **Hero Section**: Checks for `bg-gradient-to-r`, `text-transparent`, `bg-clip-text`. **Responsiveness**: Checks for a minimum of 15 responsive prefixes (`md:`, `lg:`). **Dark Mode**: Checks for a minimum of 10 `dark:` variants. **[A] Visual (250 pts)**: High-fidelity SSIM match across Mobile, Tablet, and Desktop viewport tests. **[B] Logic (250 pts)**: Exhaustive AST scan for component structure, gradient utilities, and state variants. **[C] Quality (100 pts)**: 100 pts for clean semantic HTML5 landmarks (`<header>`, `<main>`, `<section>`, `<footer>`).
common_mistakes: Applying 'md:' to mobile styles instead of desktop styles.
hints: Tailwind's grid system uses 'grid' and 'grid-cols-*' utilities.
Use 'gap-*' to add spacing between grid items.
